Staff vigilance

Parent communication
Maintain current emergency contacts and rapid notification procedures.
Incident response
Call emergency services immediately, lock down the site, preserve evidence, and document timelines.
Child education
Teach age-appropriate safety rules about trusted adults, staying with staff, and asking for help.
Drills and reviews
Run regular safety drills and update protocols after each exercise.
